segments.text: 18-річний хлопець на ім'я Джордж-молодший проїхав через своє рідне місто, повертаючись додому на вечерю
segments.original: An 18-year-old boy named George Jr. drove through his hometown on his way home for dinner.

segments.text: Але коли він їхав, Джордж-молодший відчув, що йому зовсім не хочеться туди їхати.
segments.original: But as he was driving, George Jr. could not help but feel like he was really dreading actually getting there.

segments.text: Отже, Джордж-молодший був дуже розумною дитиною, але він також дуже легко відволікався, і через це він не займався чимось настільки серйозно
segments.original: So George Jr. was a very smart kid, but he also got distracted really easily and because of that he really had not pursued anything all that seriously.

segments.text: Тобто, окрім автомобілів. І в той момент його батько дійсно купив йому маленький італійський автомобіль під назвою Fiat
segments.original: That is, except for cars. And at that point his father actually bought him a small Italian car called a Fiat.

segments.text: Але його батько, незважаючи на те, що він буквально дав йому Fiat, він ніяк не розумів, чому син так одержимий автомобілями
segments.original: But his father, despite being the one who literally gave him the Fiat, he just didn't get his son's obsession with cars.

segments.text: Наприклад, чому ти не можеш зосередитися на цьому й застосувати це до інших речей, які дадуть тобі справжню роботу?
segments.original: Like why aren't you able to take that focus and apply it to other things that will get you a real job?

segments.text: І тому практично кожна вечеря в ці дні перетворювалася на величезну суперечку між батьком і сином
segments.original: And so basically every dinner these days it became this huge argument between father and son.

segments.text: І ось Джордж, він підійшов до цього перехрестя, де воно було прямо біля його дому, і він почав повертати, коли почув цей дуже гучний вереск, а потім усе пішло. Через два тижні Джордж-молодший лежав на лікарняному ліжку у відділенні інтенсивної терапії місцевої лікарні.
segments.original: And so George, he came to this intersection where it was right near his home and he begins making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went Two weeks later, George Jr. was laying in a hospital bed in the intensive care unit at the local hospital.

segments.text: Тож за два тижні до того, коли Джордж повертав, а потім щось трапилося, це було так:
segments.original: So two weeks earlier when George was making that turn

segments.text: по дорозі мчала інша машина й так сильно врізалася в машину Джорджа, що Джорджа-молодшого викинуло з машини, але він вижив.
segments.original: and then something happened, well what it was is another car came speeding down the road and smashed into George's car so hard that George Jr. was ejected from the car but he had survived.

segments.text: Через два роки Джордж-молодший, який до цього моменту повністю одужав після травм, стояв на фініші гоночного треку й підняв камеру
segments.original: Two years later, George Jr., who by this point was fully recovered from his injuries, stood at the finish line at a racetrack and raised his camera.

segments.text: Тож після свого передсмертного досвіду Джордж-молодший зрозумів, що його тато був певною мірою правий, що певним чином він витрачав свій потенціал
segments.original: So since his near-death experience, George Jr. had realized that really his dad had been kind of right, that in some ways he was wasting his potential.

segments.text: Тож Джордж-молодший вирішив, що справді більше не хоче брати участь у автоперегонах
segments.original: So George Jr. had decided that he really didn't want to race cars anymore.

segments.text: Натомість він взяв фотоапарат і повернувся до свого старого хобі фотографії
segments.original: Instead, he had picked up his camera and really gotten back into his old hobby of photography.

segments.text: Насправді Джордж-молодший подав заявку на престижну програму кінематографії в USC,
segments.original: In fact, George Jr. had applied to the prestigious cinematography program at the University of Southern California

segments.text: але після того, як відправив свою заявку, був майже впевнений, що його не приймуть
segments.original: but after sending off his application, he was pretty sure he would not get in.

segments.text: Джордж-молодший підійшов до подіуму, щоб сфотографувати водія-переможця, але коли він ішов туди, до нього підійшов чоловік середнього віку і запитав Джорджа-молодшого про його фотографію, а потім він офіційно представився як Хаскелл Векслер і сказав, що він кінооператор у Голлівуді, а Джордж-молодший розповів Хаскеллу про те, як він нещодавно подав заяву в USC, щоб спробувати потрапити до їхньої програми з кінематографії, і коли Хаскелл почув це, він сказав:
segments.original: Now, George Jr. walked over to the podium to take some photos of the winning driver

segments.text: «Джордж, я знаю людей в USC».
segments.original: but as he walked over there, this middle-aged man came up beside him and just asked George Jr. about his photography and then at some point the man actually formally introduced himself as Haskell Wexler and he said that he was actually a cinematographer in Hollywood and George Jr. told Haskell about how he had recently applied to USC to try to get into their cinematography program and when Haskell heard this, he said, George, I know people at USC.

segments.text: Я подзвоню, і, звичайно, невдовзі після цієї доленосної зустрічі Джордж-молодший отримав лист про зарахування від кіношколи USC, але цей момент у житті Джорджа-молодшого не лише змінив його життя назавжди
segments.original: Let me make some calls and sure enough, not long after this fateful meeting, George Jr. would receive an acceptance letter from USC's film school but this moment in George Jr.'s life did not just alter George's life forever.

segments.text: Це також назавжди повністю змінить кінематограф загалом, тому що приблизно через 13 років Джордж-молодший створить один з найбільш новаторських фільмів в історії
segments.original: It also would go on to completely alter cinema in general forever because about 13 years later, George Jr. would go on to create one of the most groundbreaking films in history.

segments.text: Його фільм став частиною найуспішнішої кінофраншизи всіх часів
segments.original: His movie would go on to become part of the most successful movie franchise of all time.

segments.text: Джордж-молодший сьогодні більш відомий як Джордж Лукас, а його кінофраншиза — це «Зоряні війни»

source_segments: An 18-year-old boy named George Jr. drove through his hometown on his way home for dinner.
But as he was driving, George Jr. could not help but feel like he was really dreading actually getting there.
So George Jr. was a very smart kid, but he also got distracted really easily and because of that he really had not pursued anything all that seriously.
That is, except for cars. And at that point his father actually bought him a small Italian car called a Fiat.
But his father, despite being the one who literally gave him the Fiat, he just didn't get his son's obsession with cars.
Like why aren't you able to take that focus and apply it to other things that will get you a real job?
And so basically every dinner these days it became this huge argument between father and son.

And so George, he came to this intersection where it was right near his home and he begins making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went Two weeks later, George Jr. was laying in a hospital bed in the intensive care unit at the local hospital.
So two weeks earlier when George was making that turn
and then something happened, well what it was is another car came speeding down the road and smashed into George's car so hard that George Jr. was ejected from the car but he had survived.
Two years later, George Jr., who by this point was fully recovered from his injuries, stood at the finish line at a racetrack and raised his camera.
So since his near-death experience, George Jr. had realized that really his dad had been kind of right, that in some ways he was wasting his potential.
So George Jr. had decided that he really didn't want to race cars anymore.
Instead, he had picked up his camera and really gotten back into his old hobby of photography.
In fact, George Jr. had applied to the prestigious cinematography program at the University of Southern California
but after sending off his application, he was pretty sure he would not get in.
Now, George Jr. walked over to the podium to take some photos of the winning driver

but as he walked over there, this middle-aged man came up beside him and just asked George Jr. about his photography and then at some point the man actually formally introduced himself as Haskell Wexler and he said that he was actually a cinematographer in Hollywood and George Jr. told Haskell about how he had recently applied to USC to try to get into their cinematography program and when Haskell heard this, he said, George, I know people at USC.

Let me make some calls and sure enough, not long after this fateful meeting, George Jr. would receive an acceptance letter from USC's film school but this moment in George Jr.'s life did not just alter George's life forever.
It also would go on to completely alter cinema in general forever because about 13 years later, George Jr. would go on to create one of the most groundbreaking films in history.
His movie would go on to become part of the most successful movie franchise of all time.
George Jr. is better known today as George Lucas and his film franchise was Star Wars. better known today as George Lucas and his film franchise was Star Wars.
